build_norm_layer: build a normalization layer from a config dict with specified num_features and postfix
infer_abbr: infer the abbreviation string for a given normalization layer class type
is_norm: check if a given nn.Module layer is a normalization layer with optional exclusions
register_norm_module: register a custom normalization layer class into the NORM_LAYERS registry
review_norm_registry: review the NORM_LAYERS registry to see all registered normalization layer types
